title: Ember of Uruk
description:
Descend into Kur. There is no way out, only deeper.Beneath Uruk lies Kur, the underworld of ancient Mesopotamia. You are an Ember-bearer: you carry a lamp that holds the dark back, and you walk down Gate by Gate through reed marshes, burning oil fields, royal tombs, drowned rivers and a library that remembers too much. Every descent ends. The next one starts a little stronger.

Your weapons fire on their own. Your skill is everything else.Move, dash and time your parry. A well-timed parry counters the attack and can stagger a boss, and a staggered boss takes far more damage. Every bearer has a personal ultimate and an exclusive signature weapon with its own Fury strikes, so each one plays differently. Every Gate you clear is graded from S to D.

Build, fuse, unlockPick from more than fifty weapons, many of which fuse into stronger forms, and from more than a hundred items and tablets that change how a build plays. Between descents you spend shekels at the Bazaar of Ur, open new realms and bearers by playing, and fill the Museum of Ur with the finds you bring back. Optional cosmetic looks are sold for real money, and nothing you can buy makes you stronger.

The Gatekeeper's tollAfter every guardian falls, the Gatekeeper takes his toll. The wheel hands you a weapon you did not choose, then you pick a reward. No build runs away with the game, so each Gate is a decision about what you can live without.

Utukku, scorpions, demons and dozens of guardiansMore than fifty kinds of enemies, each with its own behaviour, swarm you in huge numbers, and the realms fight back with sandstorms, rising dust, cave-ins, stampedes and flooding. Every guardian has signature attacks, and every one ends in a finishing blow from your bearer.

Play togetherPlay solo, share one screen with up to four players, or go online through Steam: invite friends from your friends list or share a room code. Each player picks their own upgrades, fallen friends can be revived, and a co-op session can be saved and resumed when the same players return.

Pixel art and chiptunePixel art and a chiptune soundtrack with its own track for every realm and boss. 

Features• Fast top-down survivors-like action: move, dash and parry while your weapons fire on their own

• 14 bearers, each with an ultimate, a signature weapon and a rule that changes how you play

• 24 realms to open, from the Marshes of Eridu to the River of the Dead

• More than fifty weapons with fusions, more than a hundred items, and a toll after every guardian

• Boss staggers, S-to-D grades for every Gate, and a daily descent and weekly challenge

• Solo, same-screen co-op for up to four, or online co-op through Steam

• Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud saves, leaderboards and controller support

• Cosmetic skins, trails and auras, and the Museum of Ur to fill
description_short: Descend through the Mesopotamian underworld in a fast pixel-art survivors-like. Your weapons fire on their own while you dash, parry and fuse your way past swarms and bosses across 24 realms, solo or in online and same-screen co-op.
